provenance.note: Blinded single-subagent adjudication (MERGE-PLAN §2): vendor labels stripped, A/B randomized per file, candidate-pair focus. confirmed_delta promoted only after caller original-span confirmation.

base_member_text: start/stop/time are computed at L115-L117 before the block loop using kk, whose value is whatever the last logging loop left (kk=num_blocks); correct only because num_blocks=1 in this configuration
audit_member_text: The time window is computed at L116-L119 before the block loop starts at L122, using `kk` left over from the preceding completed loops (therefore the final block index). If metadata yields more than one block, all blocks reuse the final block's start/stop/time while data slicing inside the loop uses each block's `itscale(kk)` at L132-L134, creating mismatched time labels and sample counts.

base_member_text: fcur (L7) and steps (L118) are unused; same zero-station-side crash risk at L78 as the multi-block script; same strict-inequality window selection (L115-L116)
audit_member_text: `st_side_block` is conditionally assigned only when a side is encountered (L45-L70), but is unconditionally read at L78 and L129. Any absent side is a use-before-assign failure.
`fcur` is assigned at L7 but never used, and neither fopen return at L82/L213 is checked before writes.

base_member_text: printside (L224-L227) is an external function not defined in this file

header point counts use size(eta_fine{...},2) (L216-L219) while the multi-block variant uses size(eastfine,1); both equal the fine point count, but this variant omits the duplicate header block written to the log

audit_member_text: The final-row `/4` inference at L11 assumes ordered, complete side codes; no divisibility or maximum/order check precedes the block/parameter loops.
Empty time-search results from L116-L117 break subsequent slicing; a one-sample time vector also makes the interval expression `time(2)-time(1)` at L237 out of range.

Only parameter-vector lengths are checked (L26-L30). Nonpositive or fractional `iscale`/`itscale` values flow into colon steps and reciprocal interpolation grids at L118,L132-L134,L143,L154-L156 without validation.
